Since no course is a prerequisite for a Sem 8 slot, and ATAP in Sem 7 makes it the last semester used, the constraints are contradictory.

CS3281 must be before CS2105. CS2103T and CS4243 must be in the same semester. CS4243 requires a Stats course. CS2102 requires CS4243 before it. CS4221 requires CS3223 which requires CS2102. This chain is tight. ATAP in Sem 7 requires a course in Sem 8. No course can be added. Thus, no valid plan exists.
